title: You lost your *train of thought.* Now what?

head: Mid-sentence, your mind goes blank
r: Smile: "Let me put that another way"

label: STEP 1
head: Pause. Don't fill the silence.
sub: 2 quiet seconds look like thinking, not panic.

label: STEP 2
head: "Let me start that thought again"
sub: One sentence. No apology. Then keep going.

label: STEP 3
head: Never bring it up after
sub: Most people barely noticed. Don't remind them.

text: Confidence isn't never slipping. It's *not caring when you do.*

head: Have the line *ready*
sub: Say it out loud once today so it comes out naturally.
